A '''clone chief medic '''served as a [[Clone medic/Legends|clone trooper medic]] on [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]] during its evacuation of the station when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|tried to destroy it]], around the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
